RFIs and Daily Logs for a construction iOS app

Role: Product DesignerPlatform: iOSStatus: rolling out now

Ingenious.Build is a US project management platform for construction. This case study shows how I designed RFIs and Daily Logs for its new iOS app.

Inside: 12 of the 33 RFI banner states with their PRD cases. Also the Daily Log decisions and the UX notes that developers and QA worked from.

  • 33states of one RFI action banner
  • 10Daily Log categories on one pattern
